description: This file defines the EmailsViewList class, a view class for listing emails in the SuiteCRM application. It sets display parameters such as sorting order and initializes a specific ListView class for rendering email lists.

classes.name: EmailsViewList
classes.description: A view class responsible for listing email records, setting default sorting parameters, and initializing a custom ListView class for email display.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Prepares the view for display by setting order parameters and initializing the ListViewSmartyEmails object for rendering the email list.
